name: Northwest Territories
description: The Mackenzie River valley (Interior Plains) separates the Mackenzie Mountains on the west from the Canadian Shield on the east (Yellowknife, Great Slave and Great Bear lakes); the Mackenzie Delta (Inuvik) and Arctic islands lie to the north. Much of the territory has permafrost.
